articles.summary: Key features for the quarter ended September 2026 (vs September 2025) Gold production increased by 10% to 1 307kg (42 021oz), supported by a 15% improvement in yield. Operating profit increased by 42% to R1.6 billion, with revenue up 31% to approximately R3.0 billion. Growth capital expenditure decreased by 29% to R555.7 million as certain Vision 2028 projects progressed towards completion. Free cash inflow of R725.8 million, with R2.5 billion in cash and cash equivalents and no bank debt.
articles.title: DRDGOLD REPORTS 10% INCREASE IN GOLD PRODUCTION AND 42% RISE IN OPERATING PROFIT
